headline: global_avg is flat at 6.083 for the second consecutive week, so the literal stall test fires — but this audit establishes that 6.083 is the ARITHMETIC CEILING of the metric, not a plateau within it. 23 of 24 spine sequences sit at HEAD 6 (vr_testing); stage 6 is scored by a single substring match of a declared map name against ada_run/desktop_feedback.md, so no headless work of any kind can raise the mean. It is mathematically impossible for the number to improve without a human VR comment. Two sharper findings sit underneath. FIRST: the stage-6 wall is partly an EVIDENCE-LINKAGE artifact. Real VR feedback exists for 9 sequences, but the last entry is dated 2026-02-20 (158 days ago) and every walked map except one has since been dropped from its sequence's declared cast (VectorForces, One_Primitives, LSystems_Tree_L_Systems, Array_Basics still exist on disk but are no longer declared; Fractals_9's folder is gone). randomness is the project's ONE 'COMPLETE' sequence solely because Random_Rotate_Random_XYZ survived the re-cast under its original name. The entire non-6 term of the headline mean rests on one 158-day-old comment about one map. SECOND: the ask to break the wall is far smaller than previously framed — ONE feedback line naming ONE declared map per sequence would move 4 sequences to COMPLETE and 19 to stage 7, taking global_avg 6.083 -> 7.208 (+1.125), the largest jump in project history, in a single VR session. Last week's 'FRESH gate-B regression' is CORRECTED: doc/reports/RELEASE_GATES.json is a 2026-06-10 snapshot because run_release_gates.py defaults --json-out to empty and never refreshes it; the 17 flagged artifacts date to the 2026-07-08 curator/jspace/museum/pattern_atlas wave and have been stable at 17 all week. Gates hold 4/4 PASS, grade_F 0, and grade_C actually FELL 197 -> 181 while the map corpus grew 7%. The week was the most productive on record by commit volume (~200 commits) but breath cadence dropped to 3 and then stopped entirely for the last 3 days.

(a) randomness's COMPLETE status, the sole non-6 term in the headline mean, rests on ONE 158-day-old comment about ONE map that happened to survive its sequence's re-cast.
